For W=1 the vacancy expectation obeys exact diffusion with decay 6 epsilon, with the stated Fourier and integrated-response kernels. For W=1+j v_a dot v_b, the orientation generator equals (1/2)Delta m+2j epsilon A m on configurations with at most one occupied site in the radius-two neighborhood, with an explicit multiple-occupancy remainder elsewhere. For centered eigenfunctions of any positive symmetric row-sum-six six-content matrix, the same local birth term is epsilon theta A m, with the normalized vector and axis-population eigenvalues derived explicitly. For the j-family with 0<=j<1 on regular tori, the multiple-occupancy remainder yields the stated controlled Duhamel error; this does not establish an interacting finite-density closure, bulk order, gravity, relativistic dynamics or physical rate selection."
